summary: Applies Mendon's rulings on PR #344 and syncs with main (#341 R's Mochitoko rule, #359, #363, #365, #361): a negated action pays ALL its costs (64 abilities' cost statements moved to declarative AbilityDefinition.Costs), atomically, through ONE predicate CostPaymentBlockedByNegation(GameCommand) that folds R's Mochitoko block and this PR's cost list (asked over the chosen cost option and every declared cost, in both the ordinary and the whole-action-negation flow); a blocked action, a Sakuma-negated action and a negated additional action (Effortless Counterattack, which now pays its costs and loses only itself) share one taken-but-empty path.
